FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Eternal Vows Wedding Chapels specializes in providing elegant and intimate ceremony spaces for weddings, ensuring a beautiful and personalized experience for couples on their special day. Our operations are centered around hosting wedding ceremonies in a charming chapel setting, where clients can choose from various packages that include decorations, floral arrangements, and coordination services tailored to their needs. We do not permit alcohol service or host receptions beyond the ceremony to maintain a serene environment. Our dedicated team works closely with clients to ensure all aspects of the ceremony, including timelines and vendor management, are executed flawlessly. With a focus on customer satisfaction and a commitment to safety, we prioritize compliance with all local regulations to offer a memorable wedding experience in a safe atmosphere.

At our Wedding Services & Chapels, we offer a complete package for couples, which includes providing a variety of beverages, including alcoholic options, for their celebrations on our premises.
